89:3: And by the even and the odd.
89:4: And by the night when it passes.
89:5: Is there in this an oath for a possessor of intellect?
89:6: Did you not see what your Rabb did to the people of Ad?
89:8: The like of which has not been created in the cities.
89:9: And to Thamud, who carved the rocks in the valley.
89:10: And to Pharaoh, the owner of the stakes.
89:11: Those who transgressed within the lands.
89:13: Your Rabb has poured upon them a whip of punishment.
89:15: As for man, when his Rabb tests him and honors him and bestows favor upon him, he says: My Rabb has honored me.
89:16: But whenever He tests him and restricts his provision, he says: My Rabb has humiliated me.
89:17: No, on the contrary, you do not honor the orphan.
89:18: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
89:19: And you consume the inheritance, gathering it all together.
89:20: And you love wealth with a great love.
89:21: No, when the earth is shattered completely.
89:22: And your Rabb comes and the angels are rank upon rank.
89:23: And on that day Hell is brought, and on that day man remembers, but what benefit will the remembering give him?
89:24: He says: Would that I had sent ahead for my life.
89:25: On that day, no one punishes as He punishes.
89:26: And no one binds His binding.
89:28: Return to your Rabb, well-pleased and pleasing.
